standard_prerequisites.name: The sheaf of homomorphisms between two modules and the exactness of its sections over an open as a sequence of modules
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: The author's section on the internal hom, in which the counted statement occurs
standard_prerequisites.use: Fixes the sheaves whose exactness in the two displays is to be proved.

standard_prerequisites.name: The criterion that a sequence of sheaves is exact if and only if its sections over every open form an exact sequence
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof at source lines 3808-3809 as a cross-chapter pointer
standard_prerequisites.use: Converts the exactness of the sequences of sections into exactness of the displayed sequences of sheaves.

core_obligations: Sections are exact: for a right exact sequence of modules the proof observes that over every open the sequence of modules of homomorphisms out of the restrictions is exact, by the cross-chapter criterion for exactness of sequences of modules (proof lines 3802-3809)

Sheaves are exact: since taking sections over the opens of the given sheaves reproduces those exact sequences, the displayed sequence is exact as a sequence of sheaves by the very definition of exactness for sheaves (proof lines 3810-3813)
Second statement: the same argument applies to a left exact sequence in the second variable (proof line 3813)
proof_roadmap: 对开集 U，0 → Hom(F|_U,G|_U) → Hom(F_1|_U,G|_U) → Hom(F_2|_U,G|_U) 是模的正合列（跨章判据）；这正说明取截面后得到的阿贝尔群序列正合。
按层正合的定义即得所显示的层序列正合；(2) 的证明完全相同。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement records the exactness of the sheaf of homomorphisms in the first variable for a right exact sequence and in the second variable for a left exact sequence of modules on a ringed space (author lemma at source lines 3775-3799, label lemma-internal-hom-exact). The proof (source lines 3801-3814) checks exactness on the sections over each open, using the corresponding statement for modules, and concludes by the definition of exactness for sheaves; the second part is the same argument (proof lines 3802-3813). The reduction to the exactness of the sequences of sections is the content. H2.
